annotations.title: Positioning: long/short ratios, taker buy/sell and CVD across exchanges

description: Call this when the user asks about the long/short ratio, whether retail or top traders are net long or short, the taker buy/sell ratio, or CVD (cumulative volume delta) for a perpetual. Returns exchange-published statistics for the 30 most traded Binance USDT perps on every perpetual venue the positioning board records (Binance global and top-trader ratios, Bybit share long, OKX ratios and taker volume, Gate account and top-trader ratios, HTX elite ratios, Bitget account and position ratios) and CVD series for BTC, ETH and SOL; refreshed every 15 minutes. Without symbol, the 10 most traded perps and the newest 24 points of each CVD series; pass symbol, limit or cvd_points for more. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

cvd_points.description: Optional. Newest points per CVD series (1h and 5m); default 24 without symbol, every point with one.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

limit.description: Optional. Perps without symbol, most traded first (default 10, up to 30).
